name: Person Profile
definition: Information to support Know Your Customer (KYC) processes.

ForeignStatusCertification.name: Foreign Status Certification
ForeignStatusCertification.definition: Specifies if documentary evidence has been provided for the foreign resident.

EmployeeTerminationIndicator.name: Employee Termination Indicator
EmployeeTerminationIndicator.definition: Indicates if the employment of the person has been terminated.

KnowYourCustomerCheckType.name: Know Your Customer Check Type
KnowYourCustomerCheckType.definition: Specifies the type of due diligence checks carried out on a party. For definitions of ordinary, simple and enhanced know your customer checks, local market regulations should be consulted.

RiskLevel.name: Risk Level
RiskLevel.definition: Specifies the customer’s money laundering risk.

PoliticalExposureType.name: Political Exposure Type
PoliticalExposureType.definition: Specifies if due diligence checks on the political exposure of the investor have been carried out and whether these checks are national or foreign. (A politically exposed person is someone who has been entrusted with a prominent public function, or an individual who is closely related to such a person.)

CustomerConductClassification.name: Customer Conduct Classification
CustomerConductClassification.definition: Assessment of the customer’s behaviour at the time of the account opening application.

FamilyMedicalInsuranceIndicator.name: Family Medical Insurance Indicator
FamilyMedicalInsuranceIndicator.definition: Indicates if the person has family medical insurance coverage available.

SourceOfWealth.name: Source Of Wealth
SourceOfWealth.definition: Indicates the main sources of the money.

PoliticallyExposedStatus.name: Politically Exposed Status
PoliticallyExposedStatus.definition: Status of the politically exposed person.

Person.name: Person
Person.definition: Person for which the profile parameters are described.

ProfileCertification.name: Profile Certification
ProfileCertification.definition: Information to support the Know Your Customer processes.
